response.overview: Cj, an immortal former rebel leader, must navigate a treacherous web of ancient magic and modern law enforcement as he seeks to retrieve a powerful family pendant and defeat his malevolent, soul-consuming brother, Zarek. Along the way, he is forced to confront his centuries-long history of conflict while discovering that the allies he trusts may be part of a much larger, more dangerous conspiracy.
response.title: Highly Favoured
